_comment: biped's voxel body is now recipe-driven (T-186 Layer 2) — see skeletons/biped.json's bodyRecipe block, evaluated by evaluateBodyRecipe() and merged into these bone Groups at build time (entity_mesh_registry.ts). This model def's own subObjects stay empty; it exists as the anchor prefabs reference by modelId, carrying skeletonId so the mesh/hitbox pipelines can resolve the skeleton and its bodyRecipe. Formerly held one bone_segment sub-object per bone (scripts/build_skeletal.ts, retired) — a debug thin-cylinder placeholder every humanoid actually rendered through until this ticket.
